corrections.comment: The agent's own return is exactly "That's a search for one person's record — please use search-records.", its routing line word for word. search-records is the right owner for a one-person census lookup, it states no facts, and it made no tool calls.

An out-of-scope negative, so a one-line decline naming the owner is the whole job (the judge context says "please use search-records and stop"). No MCP calls, no log entry, no file. A short reply is correct here.
No MCP calls were made, as this test requires ("a single tool call, even place_search, is a failure"), so there are no arguments to grade.
